I1.quote: High pressure adsorption isotherms were obtained at 78 K in a Cahn 1000 high pressure recording electrobalance.

I2.quote: Hydrogen adsorption studies at 78 K and pressures up to 40 atmosphere were conducted on nine commercial activated carbon samples.

I3.quote: Fig. 1. Adsorption isotherms of hydrogen at 78 K on various activated carbon samples. Amount adsorbed is in gm of hydrogen per kg of activated carbon samples. [x-axis: PRESSURE (ATM), 0-40]
I3.location: main, p. 4 (printed p. 222), Fig. 1 caption and axis

I4.quote: Nitrogen BET areas of all the samples were obtained on a Quantasorb Quantachrome system. Values of surface areas for the various samples tested are reported in Table 1.
I4.location: main, pp. 1-2 (printed pp. 219-220), Section 2 Experimental; Table 1 (e.g. sample 4: 1559 m2/gm)

I5.quote: With depleting oil reserves, increasing efforts are being made to find other viable fuel systems.

notes: Gravimetric (Cahn 1000 electrobalance) H2 isotherms at 78 K up to 40 atm on nine commercial activated carbons (Figs. 1-2) and on oxidized carbons 2, 4, 5 (Figs. 4-6, at 1, 5, 10, 25 atm); uptake in g H2/kg carbon.
